task: A barista you see every morning greets you. Say yes and add a small detail.
say: Morning! The usual?
zh: 每天早上见到的咖啡师跟你打招呼。说“是的”，再加一个小细节。对方说：“早上好！老样子？”
example: Yes please, a flat white. Actually, make it a large today. It's been one of those mornings.

task: The barista asks about your day. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: Busy day ahead?
zh: 咖啡师问你今天怎么样。回答，加一个细节，再反问对方。对方说：“今天会很忙吗？”
example: Yeah, pretty full on. Back-to-back meetings all afternoon. What about you, been flat out since you opened?

task: The person at the supermarket checkout asks you a question. Answer and add a light comment.
say: Did you find everything okay?
zh: 超市收银员问你一个问题。回答，再加一句轻松的话。对方说：“东西都找到了吗？”
example: Yep, all good, thanks. Except the avocados. They were all rock hard, so I gave up.

task: You arrive at a hotel. The receptionist asks about your trip. Answer and add a detail.
say: Welcome! How was the trip in?
zh: 你到了酒店，前台问你路上怎么样。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“欢迎！路上还顺利吗？”
example: Not bad, thanks. Bit of traffic coming out of the airport, but we got here in the end.

task: A waiter checks on your table during dinner. Say something nice about the food.
say: How is everything?
zh: 吃饭时服务员过来问情况。夸一下食物。对方说：“一切都还好吗？”
example: Really good, thanks. The fish is cooked perfectly. Could we grab some more water when you get a chance?

task: You are at the bank counter and you have finished. End the chat politely.
say: Anything else I can help you with today?
zh: 你在银行柜台办完了事。礼貌地结束对话。对方说：“今天还有别的需要帮忙的吗？”
example: No, that's everything, thanks. You've been really helpful. Have a good afternoon.

task: Your hairdresser asks about your plans. Answer and ask back.
say: Doing anything nice today?
zh: 理发师问你今天的安排。回答，再反问对方。对方说：“今天有什么好安排吗？”
example: Just catching up with a mate for lunch later. Nothing too exciting. What about you, are you working all day?

task: Your Uber driver picks you up after work. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: Been a long day?
zh: 下班后 Uber 司机接你。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“今天很累吧？”
example: Yeah, a pretty long one. We had a deadline at work. Have you been driving all day?

task: You come into the gym at 6 am. The person at the front desk greets you. Answer with a reason.
say: Morning! Early start today?
zh: 你早上六点到健身房，前台跟你打招呼。回答并说明原因。对方说：“早！今天这么早？”
example: Yeah, trying to get in before work. It's the only time the place isn't packed.

task: You are at the doctor's (GP) and you feel unwell. The receptionist greets you. Answer honestly but lightly.
say: Hi there, how are you today?
zh: 你在家庭医生诊所，身体不太舒服。前台跟你打招呼。如实但轻松地回答。对方说：“你好，今天怎么样？”
example: Not too flash, to be honest. Bit of a sore throat. I've got an appointment with Dr Lee at ten.

task: The barista likes your jacket. Accept the compliment and add a detail.
say: Love your jacket. Where'd you get it?
zh: 咖啡师喜欢你的夹克。接受夸奖，再加一个细节。对方说：“你的夹克真好看，在哪儿买的？”
example: Oh, thanks! I got it on sale last winter. It's pretty much all I wear now.

task: The GP receptionist tells you there is a delay. React calmly and politely.
say: Sorry, the doctor's running about twenty minutes late.
zh: 诊所前台告诉你要等一会儿。平静、礼貌地回应。对方说：“抱歉，医生大概要晚二十分钟。”
example: No worries at all, I'm not in a rush. Is it okay if I pop out for a coffee and come back?

task: A plumber has just fixed your sink. Thank them and ask a useful follow-up question.
say: Right, that's sorted. You shouldn't have any more trouble with that.
zh: 水管工刚修好你的水槽。感谢对方，再问一个有用的问题。对方说：“好了，搞定了。应该不会再出问题了。”
example: Legend, thanks so much. Out of interest, is there anything I can do to stop it happening again?

task: You are at an open home. The real-estate agent chats to you. Answer and add a detail.
say: So what brings you out today? Just having a look?
zh: 你在看房开放日，房产中介跟你聊天。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“今天怎么过来看看？随便看看吗？”
example: Yeah, just having a look for now. We're renting nearby and thinking about buying sometime next year.

task: Your Uber driver asks about your job. Answer with a detail and ask back.
say: So what do you do for work?
zh: Uber 司机问你做什么工作。回答并加一个细节，再反问。对方说：“你是做什么工作的？”
example: I'm in IT, mostly looking after cloud systems for a company in town. Do you drive full-time, or is it more of a side thing?

task: Your hairdresser asks about holidays. Answer and add a detail.
say: Got any holidays coming up?
zh: 理发师问你最近有没有假期安排。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“最近有假期安排吗？”
example: Yeah, heading to Queenstown in a few weeks. Hoping to do a bit of skiing, as long as I don't break anything.

task: You arrive at the café and the barista talks about the rain. Agree lightly and add a detail.
say: Did you see the rain this morning? Absolutely bucketing down.
zh: 你到了咖啡店，咖啡师聊起下雨。轻松地表示同意，再加一个细节。对方说：“看到早上那场雨了吗？简直是倾盆大雨。”
example: Oh, tell me about it. I got soaked just walking from the car. My shoes are still squelching.

task: The hotel receptionist asks why you are in town. Answer and ask for a recommendation.
say: Are you here for work or pleasure?
zh: 酒店前台问你来这里是出差还是游玩。回答，再请对方推荐。对方说：“你是来出差还是来玩的？”
example: Bit of both, actually. I've got a conference tomorrow, but the weekend's free. Anywhere good for dinner around here?

task: The gym front desk asks about the new classes. Give your opinion with a detail.
say: How are you finding the new classes?
zh: 健身房前台问你觉得新课程怎么样。说说你的看法并加一个细节。对方说：“新课程你觉得怎么样？”
example: Really enjoying them. The Tuesday spin class nearly killed me, but in a good way.

task: You are at a new restaurant. The waiter asks a question. Answer and show interest by asking for advice.
say: Have you been here before?
zh: 你在一家新餐厅，服务员问你一个问题。回答，并请对方推荐，表示兴趣。对方说：“你以前来过吗？”
example: No, first time. A friend said the pork belly's amazing. What would you recommend?

task: An electrician is working at your house and makes conversation. Answer, add a detail and ask back.
say: Nice place you've got. How long have you been here?
zh: 电工在你家干活，跟你闲聊。回答，加个细节，再反问。对方说：“你家挺不错的。住了多久了？”
example: Thanks! About two years now. Still slowly fixing things up. Do you get to see a lot of houses round here?

task: At the checkout you are buying a lot of party food. Answer and add a detail.
say: Ooh, someone's having a party!
zh: 你在超市买了很多聚会吃的，收银员跟你搭话。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“哦，有人要开派对了！”
example: Ha, yeah, a few friends are coming over for the rugby tomorrow. Better have enough chips. Wish me luck!

task: Your regular barista shares some news. React with surprise and ask a follow-up question.
say: I'm finishing up here on Friday, actually. Moving to Melbourne.
zh: 常去的咖啡店的咖啡师告诉你一个消息。表示惊讶，再追问一个问题。对方说：“其实我这周五就做到最后一天了，要搬去墨尔本。”
example: No way! We'll really miss you here. What's taking you to Melbourne, a new job?

task: Your hairdresser has just come back from a trip. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: I only got back from Bali on Sunday. Still recovering!
zh: 理发师刚旅行回来。表示兴趣，追问一个问题。对方说：“我周日才从巴厘岛回来，还没缓过来！”
example: Oh nice, lucky you! How was it? Did you get out and about, or was it mainly beach time?

task: At an open home, the agent asks your opinion. You don't love it. Disagree politely.
say: What do you reckon about the kitchen? It's just been redone.
zh: 看房时中介问你的看法，你不太喜欢。礼貌地表达不同意见。对方说：“你觉得厨房怎么样？刚重新装修过。”
example: It looks great, really modern. I'm just not sure there's enough bench space for us. We cook a lot.

task: You are signing papers for your first home at the bank. The bank officer chats. React and add a detail.
say: You must be excited about the new house!
zh: 你在银行签首套房的文件，银行职员跟你聊天。表达感受并加一个细节。对方说：“新房子一定让你很兴奋吧！”
example: Excited and a bit terrified, to be honest. It's the biggest thing I've ever bought. But yeah, I can't wait to move in.

task: At the checkout you are buying ingredients for a new dish. Answer and add a detail.
say: Ooh, making something good tonight?
zh: 你在超市买新菜的食材，收银员跟你搭话。回答并加一个细节。对方说：“哦，今晚要做好吃的？”
example: Trying a laksa recipe a friend gave me. Fingers crossed. If it goes wrong, it's toast for dinner.

task: You haven't been to the gym for a month. The front desk notices. Explain lightly.
say: Haven't seen you for a while! Everything alright?
zh: 你一个月没去健身房了，前台注意到了。轻松地解释一下。对方说：“好久没见你了！一切都好吗？”
example: Yeah, all good, just a crazy month at work. I'm trying to get back into it now. Go easy on me!

task: You are checking out of a hotel. Give friendly feedback, including one small problem.
say: How was your stay with us?
zh: 你在酒店退房。友好地给反馈，顺便提一个小问题。对方说：“这次入住还满意吗？”
example: Really lovely, thanks. The bed was super comfy. Just a heads-up, the shower in 204 takes ages to get hot.

task: A tradie checks your hot water and gives you some news. Show interest with a follow-up question.
say: You'll need a new hot water cylinder at some point. This one's pretty old.
zh: 师傅检查了你的热水器，告诉你一个情况。表示关心，追问一个问题。对方说：“你迟早得换个新热水罐，这个挺旧了。”
example: Ah, good to know. Roughly how long do you reckon it's got left? Just so I can start saving.

task: Your Uber driver says something funny. React with humour.
say: Sorry about the smell. My last passenger had fish and chips.
zh: Uber 司机说了句好笑的话。用幽默回应。对方说：“不好意思有味道，上一位乘客吃了炸鱼薯条。”
example: Ha, no worries, now I'm starving. You don't know a good chippy near my place, do you?

task: Your hairdresser has finished. Your hair is shorter than you wanted. Give an honest but kind answer.
say: So, what do you think? Not too short?
zh: 理发师剪完了，比你想要的短。诚实但友善地回答。对方说：“你觉得怎么样？不会太短吧？”
example: Hmm, it's a bit shorter than I'm used to, but I think I like it. And hey, it'll grow back.

task: The barista makes a comment about you. Answer with a bit of humour and explain your job.
say: You always look like you're deep in thought. What do you do?
zh: 咖啡师对你说了句评论。带点幽默地回答，并说说你的工作。对方说：“你总是一副在深思的样子，你是做什么的？”
example: Ha, I'm a software developer, so I'm usually working out why something broke. The coffee definitely helps.

task: The waiter is telling you a long story, but you need the bill. End the chat politely.
say: And the chef said nobody would order it, but now it's our best seller!
zh: 服务员在讲一个长故事，但你需要买单。礼貌地结束对话。对方说：“主厨还说没人会点这道菜，结果现在成了我们卖得最好的！”
example: Ha, good on him for proving them wrong. Could we grab the bill, actually? We've got a movie at eight.

task: At an open home, the agent wants your phone number. You are not ready. Deflect politely.
say: Can I grab your number? I'll let you know if anything similar comes up.
zh: 看房时中介想要你的电话号码，你还没准备好。礼貌地推开。对方说：“能留个电话吗？有类似的房子我通知你。”
example: Thanks, but we're still early days. I'll take one of your cards and get in touch when we're more serious.

task: The GP receptionist hasn't seen you before. Tell a short personal story.
say: Have you been with us long? I don't think I've seen you before.
zh: 诊所前台以前没见过你。讲一个简短的个人经历。对方说：“你在我们这儿看病很久了吗？我好像没见过你。”
example: Only about a year. I moved up from Wellington for work. Honestly, I just haven't been sick much, touch wood.

task: The gym front desk invites you to a challenge. Decline nicely and leave the door open.
say: Want to sign up for the twelve-week challenge? It starts Monday.
zh: 健身房前台邀请你参加一个挑战。友好地拒绝，但留有余地。对方说：“要报名参加十二周挑战吗？周一开始。”
example: Ooh, tempting, but I've got a lot on at work right now. Maybe the next one? Let me know when it's coming up.

task: An electrician is not happy with your old wiring. React with humour and share a short story.
say: Who did the wiring in here? It's a bit of a dog's breakfast.
zh: 电工对你家的旧线路不满意。用幽默回应，再讲一个小故事。对方说：“这儿的线谁接的？乱七八糟的。”
example: Ha, no idea, it was like that when we bought it. The hallway light only works if you flick the switch twice.

task: Your hotel room isn't ready. Stay friendly and ask what is possible.
say: I'm so sorry, there's been a mix-up and your room isn't ready yet.
zh: 你的酒店房间还没准备好。保持友好，问问能怎么安排。对方说：“非常抱歉，出了点差错，你的房间还没准备好。”
example: Ah, these things happen. Is there somewhere I can leave my bags? I might grab a coffee and have a wander.

task: The barista remembers a big order you made. Tell a short funny story about it.
say: You're the one who ordered eight coffees last week, eh? Big meeting?
zh: 咖啡师记得你上次点了很多杯咖啡。讲一个简短有趣的小故事。对方说：“你就是上周点了八杯咖啡的那位吧？开大会吗？”
example: Ha, yes, that was me. Our team had a big release that night, so I was trying to bribe everyone. It mostly worked.
